This asset package includes two OFL-licensed derivative fonts.

Dormi Story Hand is derived from Nanum DongHwaDdoBag / 나눔손글씨 동화또박.
Copyright © 2019 NAVER Corporation. All rights reserved. Font created by CLOVA AI OCR Team.
Source: https://hangeul.pstatic.net/hangeul_static/webfont/clova/NanumDongHwaDdoBag.ttf

Dormi Gentle Pen is derived from NanumBarunpen / 나눔바른펜.
Copyright © 2014 NHN Corporation. All rights reserved. Font designed by YoonDesign Inc.
Source: https://hangeul.pstatic.net/hangeul_static/webfont/NanumBarunpen/NanumBarunpenR.ttf

Modifications: removed TrueType bytecode hinting, converted to WOFF2, replaced reserved family names, created optional current-game-copy subsets. Glyph outlines and advance widths are unchanged in the full files. The UI subsets omit unused glyphs.
The modified fonts remain under SIL Open Font License 1.1. The original copyright notices and full license are included in NAVER-OFL-1.1.txt. No endorsement by NAVER, NHN or YoonDesign is implied.

Official redistribution/license notice: https://hangeul.naver.com/font
Official full license: https://help.naver.com/service/30016/contents/18088?osType=PC&lang=ko
Official stylesheet identifying the font files: https://m-hangeul.naver.com/css/fonts.css?20241022
Downloaded and checked: 2026-10-03 UTC.

Dormi Gentle Pen Bold, derived from NanumBarunpen Bold.
Source: https://hangeul.pstatic.net/hangeul_static/webfont/NanumBarunpen/NanumBarunpenB.ttf
Original weight 700 and glyph outlines preserved. Hint programs removed, renamed derivative, converted to WOFF2 under the same Naver SIL Open Font License 1.1.
